calculation.description: Ranks assets contrarian to their 20-day volatility-normalized cumulative return, with the momentum magnitude weighted by the fraction of positive sessions. The full signal is lagged one completed trading day before forecasting next-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: Spearman cross-sectional daily IC, sign inverted from the tested consistency-weighted momentum. Pre-2027 IC 0.074214 (103 dates), 2027-2028 IC 0.019045 (521 dates), 2029-to-validation IC 0.017075 (97 dates). Results are positive across all reported regimes but uncertainty remains material with a 15-asset universe. Admission gates are absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840; both pass.
